gratefuldead.module.noClip.messages.setb: You have been set back by the server! Make sure you are already standing inside of a block.
gratefuldead.module.noEntityInteract.des: Prevents you from interacting with entities.
gratefuldead.module.noFOV.description: Disables FOV from changing during movement.
gratefuldead.module.noFall.description: Protects you from taking fall damage.
gratefuldead.module.noHurtCam.descriptio: Disables the camera effect when getting hurt.
gratefuldead.module.noInterpolation.desc: Reduces entity interpolation steps to make position updates appear more immediate.
gratefuldead.module.noMissCooldown.descr: Disables 1.8 hit cooldown or cancels missed attacks entirely.
gratefuldead.module.noPitchLimit.descrip: Allows you to rotate your head beyond the regular limits.
gratefuldead.module.noPose.description: Prevents entity pose changes for low version servers.
gratefuldead.module.noPush.description: Protects you from being pushed around by other players.
gratefuldead.module.noRotateSet.descript: Prevents the server from being able to rotate your head.
gratefuldead.module.noSlotSet.descriptio: Disallows forced slot changes by server.
gratefuldead.module.noSlow.description: Cancels slowness effects caused by blocks and using items.
gratefuldead.module.noSlowBreak.descript: Automatically adjusts breaking speed when in negatively affecting situations.
gratefuldead.module.noWeb.description: Disables slow down caused by webs.
gratefuldead.module.notebot.description: Automatically plays note block songs from NBS (Note Block Song) file.
gratefuldead.module.notebot.messages.inC: You can't use this module in creative mode!
gratefuldead.module.notebot.messages.not: Not enough note blocks in range, required are:
You must be in game to use this module.
gratefuldead.module.notebot.messages.pac: The Notebot Module is incompatible with PacketMine!
gratefuldead.module.notifier.description: Notifies you about all kinds of events.
gratefuldead.module.nuker.description: Automatically destroys all blocks in your area. Be careful!
gratefuldead.module.packetLogger.descrip: Prints all packets and their fields.
gratefuldead.module.packetMine.descripti: Allows you to mine blocks by clicking them once.
Either choose another switch method or install via fabric plus!
gratefuldead.module.parkour.description: Automatically jumps at the very edge of a block.
gratefuldead.module.particles.descriptio: Displays particles when attacking an entity.
gratefuldead.module.phase.description: Allows you to phase through blocks by exploiting the anti-cheat.
gratefuldead.module.pingSpoof.descriptio: Spoofs your ping to a specified value.
gratefuldead.module.pingSpoof.messages.c: PingSpoof cannot be enabled in single player.
gratefuldead.module.plugins.description: Attempts to list all plugins installed on the server.
gratefuldead.module.portalMenu.descripti: Allows you to open menus while standing inside a portal.
gratefuldead.module.potionFX.description: Renders visual aura effects around players, splash, and lingering potions.
gratefuldead.module.potionSpoof.descript: Allows the player to have potion effects without actually having the potion.
gratefuldead.module.projectileAimbot.des: Automatically aims at targets using projectile weapons like bows.
gratefuldead.module.projectilePuncher.de: Shoots back incoming projectiles around you.
gratefuldead.module.protectionZones.desc: Allows you to see areas protected by protection blocks and suggests optimal placement spots.
gratefuldead.module.quickPerspectiveSwap: Allows you to quickly change the game's perspective.
gratefuldead.module.radar.description: Shows the direction of rendered entities on GUI.
gratefuldead.module.replenish.descriptio: Automatically refills your hotbar with items from your inventory when the count drops to a certain threshold.
gratefuldead.module.reportHelper.descrip: Automatically starts a report and confirms it for you.
gratefuldead.module.resetVL.description: Resets anticheat violations on flawed anti-cheats.
gratefuldead.module.resourceSpoof.descri: Makes it seem like you accepted a resource pack to the server.
gratefuldead.module.reverseStep.descript: Makes you step down blocks faster.
gratefuldead.module.rotations.descriptio: Allows you to see server-sided rotations.
gratefuldead.module.safeWalk.description: Prevents you from falling down block (as if you were sneaking).
gratefuldead.module.scaffold.description: Automatically places blocks beneath your feet allowing you to walk across gaps.
gratefuldead.module.scaffold.messages.hy: This tower only works only when standing still.
Please use 1.8.x as protocol for this tower to work.
gratefuldead.module.serverCrasher.descri: Attempts to crash the server by exploiting known bugs.
gratefuldead.module.serverCrasher.messag: You need to be holding a bundle containing at least one item.
Successfully altered sign packet with exploit.
ViaFabricPlus is required for this exploit to work.
Select 1.8 as protocol version for this exploit to work.
Server Crasher is intended for multiplayer servers only.
gratefuldead.module.silentHotbar.descrip: Disables showing silently selected items in your hand.
gratefuldead.module.skinChanger.descript: Hides the player's real skin client-side (useful for videos).
gratefuldead.module.skinDerp.description: Makes the different layers of your skin turn on and off.
gratefuldead.module.sleepWalker.descript: Allows you to walk while sleeping and decreases the size of your hit box.
gratefuldead.module.smartEat.description: Automatically eats food when your hunger is low.
gratefuldead.module.snapTap.description: Prioritize the last pressed movement key.
gratefuldead.module.spammer.description: Spams the chat with specified messages.
gratefuldead.module.spearKill.descriptio: Automatically attacks enemies using a charged spear.
gratefuldead.module.spider.description: Allows you to climb walls like spiderman.
gratefuldead.module.step.description: Allows you to step up blocks faster.
gratefuldead.module.storageESP.descripti: Highlights all blocks that can contain items allowing you to see them rough walls.
gratefuldead.module.strafe.description: Allows you to strafe while being in mid-air.
gratefuldead.module.autoRTP.description: Uses a server RTP command until a target distance, once, repeatedly, or until Base Finder detects signs.
gratefuldead.module.baseFinder.descripti: Ranks possible player bases from nearby storage, workstations and redstone in loaded chunks.
gratefuldead.module.strongholdFinder.des: Tracks Eye of Ender throws and predicts the strongest stronghold chunk candidate.
gratefuldead.module.superKnockback.descr: Increases knockback dealt to other entities.
gratefuldead.module.surround.description: Builds holes that protect you from explosion damage.
gratefuldead.module.swingFix.description: Fixes swing packet order for 1.8 servers in-case their anti-cheat is outdated.
gratefuldead.module.swordBlock.descripti: Enables 1.8 sword blocking on servers using ViaVersion
gratefuldead.module.targetLock.descripti: Makes you attack only one specific enemy.
No longer locked on %s because they are out of range.
No longer locked on %s because the time is up.
gratefuldead.module.targetStrafe.descrip: Automatically strafes around enemies targeted by KillAura.
gratefuldead.module.targets.description: Allows you to manage which entities are considered to be your targets.
gratefuldead.module.teams.description: Prevents KillAura from attacking team mates.
gratefuldead.module.teleport.messages.te: %s server-side teleports left until you are being teleported to your desired location.
gratefuldead.module.teleport.messages.us: Use .tp x y z to teleport to a specific location
gratefuldead.module.terrainSpeed.descrip: Allows you to move faster on specific surfaces.
gratefuldead.module.textFieldProtect.des: Hides rendered text of text field widget when it matches certain patterns.
gratefuldead.module.tickBase.description: Buffer ticks to get early hits on an enemy.
gratefuldead.module.timeShift.descriptio: Abuses Minecraft 1.8 mechanics to allow faster regeneration and removes negative status effects like fire and poison.
gratefuldead.module.timeShift.messages.w: WARNING: Time Shift (Regen, Zoot, etc.) is only supported on 1.8 Minecraft Server! However, your client version can be higher (1.17+) in order to bypass.
gratefuldead.module.timer.description: Changes the speed the game is running at.
gratefuldead.module.timerRange.descripti: Accelerates the game time when being within the range of an enemy.
gratefuldead.module.totemEffect.descript: Renders an effect when players use a totem of undying.
gratefuldead.module.tpAura.description: Automatically teleports and attacks enemies around you.
gratefuldead.module.tracers.description: Draws a line to targets within a certain radius.
gratefuldead.module.trajectories.descrip: Allows you to see where projectiles will land.
gratefuldead.module.translation.descript: Setting up an auto translator for a client.
gratefuldead.module.translationFix.descr: Prevents servers from knowing about your installed mods through the vanilla translation vulnerability.
gratefuldead.module.tridentBoost.descrip: Strengthens the riptide dash of a trident and allows it to be used on dry land.
gratefuldead.module.trueSight.descriptio: Allows you to see invisible objects and entities.
gratefuldead.module.vehicleBoost.descrip: Boost you when leaving a vehicle.
gratefuldead.module.vehicleControl.descr: Allows you to fly and speed while riding an entity (like boats or horses).
gratefuldead.module.vehicleControl.messa: To exit the vehicle, land on the ground and press the sneak button.
The vehicle is too far away to be reached.
gratefuldead.module.vehicleOneHit.descri: Allows you to break any vehicle with a single hit.
gratefuldead.module.velocity.description: Modifies the amount of velocity you take.
gratefuldead.module.voidEsp.description: Highlight all surrounding positions that may be void.
gratefuldead.module.vomit.description: Vomit items out of your inventory.
gratefuldead.module.yggdrasilSignatureFi: Disables Authlib Yggdrasil signature check, may fix missing skins on some servers.
gratefuldead.module.zoom.description: Allows you to make everything in your world appear smaller or bigger.
Therefore falling back to %s angle smoothing.
gratefuldead.unsupportedDeepLearning: The AI engine has not been initialized. Your system might not be supported.
